en.name: Qianke
en.ability: Each night, you choose two alive players: if they are the same alignment, any player using their own ability to target one of them will instead target the other player tonight.

revisions.v1: Each night, you choose two alive players: if they are the same alignment, any player using their own ability to target one of them will instead target the other player tonight.

zh.name: 掮客
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择两名存活玩家：如果他们阵营相同，今晚任何玩家使用自身能力选择他们之一作为目标时，改为选中另一名玩家。

zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒掮客，让他选择两名玩家，如果这两名玩家阵营相同，放置"熟客"标记。
